record.title: Reviewer initial and finalize endpoints omit training_scope.resolve('review') and training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid)
record.description: In app/routes/api/reviewing.py, all read and allocation endpoints (get_allocation, allocate, release_allocation, stats, projects, available, history) call training_scope.resolve('review'), and allocate additionally checks training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid). Likewise, all coder assessment write endpoints in app/routes/api/coding.py (initial, finalize, not_codeable) and the shared DORIS clinical context in app/routes/api/doris_clinical.py (_clinical_context) call training_scope.resolve(...) and verify training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid). However, POST /api/v1/reviewing/finalize/<va_sid> (finalize, lines 219-282) and POST /api/v1/reviewing/initial/<va_sid> (initial, lines 285-343) in app/routes/api/reviewing.py omit both training_scope.resolve('review') and training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid), and submit_reviewer_final_cod (lines 533-540) and submit_reviewer_initial_cod (lines 808-815) in app/services/reviewer_coding_service.py do not check VaAllocations.va_allocation_training.is_(training_scope.on_training_side()). Although require_reviewer_access still enforces Action.REVIEW grant reach on va_sid, requests to these two endpoints ignore ?training=1, skip training_demo_service.may_use_area(current_user.user_id, 'review') when ?training=1 is passed, and allow cross-boundary reviewer assessment writes between real work (training=0 or absent, where training_scope.current() defaults to EXCLUDE) and the training project (TRN01, ?training=1).
record.claimed_root_cause: app/routes/api/reviewing.py#finalize (lines 219-282) and app/routes/api/reviewing.py#initial (lines 285-343) do not call training_scope.resolve('review') or check training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid) before invoking submit_reviewer_final_cod and submit_reviewer_initial_cod in app/services/reviewer_coding_service.py, and those service functions do not filter the active VaAllocations lookup by VaAllocations.va_allocation_training.is_(training_scope.on_training_side()).

trace.description: POST /api/v1/reviewing/finalize/<va_sid> accepts a reviewer final COD request with va_sid and optional ?training= query parameter without calling training_scope.resolve('review') or training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid).
finalize delegates directly to submit_reviewer_final_cod(current_user, va_sid, ...) while the request scope remains at the default training_scope.EXCLUDE regardless of ?training=.
submit_reviewer_final_cod queries VaAllocations for an active reviewing allocation on va_sid without filtering on VaAllocations.va_allocation_training.is_(training_scope.on_training_side()).

POST /api/v1/reviewing/initial/<va_sid> similarly accepts a reviewer Step 1 COD request without calling training_scope.resolve('review') or training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid) before calling submit_reviewer_initial_cod at line 320.
submit_reviewer_initial_cod queries VaAllocations for an active reviewing allocation on va_sid without filtering on VaAllocations.va_allocation_training.is_(training_scope.on_training_side()).

create_reviewer_final_assessment (and create_reviewer_initial_assessment at line 901) persists the reviewer assessment and transitions the submission workflow state across the real/training scope boundary.

evidence.description: allocate(va_sid) in the same blueprint calls training_scope.resolve('review') and checks training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid) at line 117, returning 409 not_available across the training/real line.
finalize(va_sid) starts with get_project_for_submission(va_sid) and never calls training_scope.resolve('review') or training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid).
initial(va_sid) starts with get_project_for_submission(va_sid) and never calls training_scope.resolve('review') or training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid).

By contrast, coder initial(va_sid) (lines 538-543) and finalize(va_sid) (lines 584-589) call training_scope.resolve('coding') and refuse cross-scope writes with 409 not_available via training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid).

_clinical_context calls training_scope.resolve('review' if role == 'reviewer' else 'coding'), checks training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid) at line 123, and filters VaAllocations by VaAllocations.va_allocation_training == training_scope.on_training_side() at line 148.
training_scope.current() defaults to EXCLUDE on every request unless resolve() is called, and sid_allowed(va_sid) at line 178 only runs when explicitly invoked.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox execution (no external network, empty allowlisted environment, read-only target and tool mounts, scratch-only writes, and explicit resource and wall-clock limits) is unavailable on this VM to run the Flask test client against a disposable test database.

validation_plan.local: Inside an approved sandbox with an isolated disposable PostgreSQL test database, run a non-destructive pytest case extending ReviewingScopeTests in tests/test_training_scope.py: allocate both REAL_SID (without ?training=1) and self.training_sid (with ?training=1), then send POST /api/v1/reviewing/initial/<training_sid> and POST /api/v1/reviewing/finalize/<training_sid> without ?training=1, and POST /api/v1/reviewing/initial/<REAL_SID>?training=1 and POST /api/v1/reviewing/finalize/<REAL_SID>?training=1. Observe that they are not rejected with 409 not_available (unlike the corresponding /api/v1/coding/initial and /api/v1/coding/finalize routes in test_recode_and_code_now_are_refused_across_the_line).
validation_plan.deployment: Do not test against shared or production data. In a local or staging test environment using synthetic test accounts and disposable test submissions, verify that adding training_scope.resolve('review') and if not training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid): return _error('This case is not available in this area.', 409, code='not_available') to initial and finalize in app/routes/api/reviewing.py causes cross-scope requests to return HTTP 409 not_available and unauthorized ?training=1 requests to return HTTP 403 forbidden.
